answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond locked for one epoch and earn reputation only through attested useful work, so identity is expensive to mint and cheap to lose. An attacker spawning ten thousand clones must fund ten thousand bonds and pay compute for each, a cost growing linearly while honest profit stays flat, like catching a comet with bare hands. Slashing burns the bond of any identity caught copying answers, so the ferrous chain of penalties holds after rebranding: the jade seal of a long attested history cannot be faked overnight, and new clones start at zero trust.
